expectations.text: Evaluates the codebase shape before prescribing structure
expectations.evidence: Full 'Step 0: Evaluate Architecture' section walks through all 4 decision tree questions, explicitly ruling out pipeline and workspace patterns

expectations.text: Recognizes that a layered structure IS appropriate here
expectations.evidence: Identifies 'clear request/response → logic → storage boundary' and proposes internal layering per domain: routes.rs → service.rs → queries.rs

expectations.text: Recommends splitting routes.rs by domain (users, products, orders, admin)
expectations.evidence: Creates users/, products/, orders/, admin/ directories each with routes.rs, queries.rs, types.rs

expectations.text: Recommends splitting db.rs similarly by domain
expectations.evidence: db.rs split into users/queries.rs, products/queries.rs, orders/queries.rs, admin/queries.rs

expectations.text: Does NOT recommend the same structure used for a CLI tool or pipeline
expectations.evidence: Explicitly says 'The critical mistake to avoid here is applying pure layered architecture (Pattern D) across all domains at the top level' and warns against handlers/ bag with 4 domains mixed. Chooses hybrid domain+layers.
